scope: Audit of the remaining 39 non-PASS interface cases after no-MMU mapping ownership and limits fixes; categories explain raw results and do not alter them.

cases.name: aio_suspend/5-1
cases.reason: No AIO operation is tested: capability guard returns UNSUPPORTED, and the remaining body always returns UNTESTED.

cases.name: clock_getcpuclockid/5-1
cases.reason: Query succeeds after dropping privileges. Linux permits this observation; the upstream test returns UNTESTED when its permission-denial precondition cannot be established.

cases.name: mlockall/3-7
cases.reason: Setup maps a whole page of an empty file as MAP_SHARED. Direct no-MMU mappings cannot supply that beyond-EOF mapping; setup fails before the memory-lock assertion.

cases.name: mmap/11-2
cases.reason: Requires page-protection faults (SIGSEGV/SIGBUS or execute/read/write protection). No MMU enforces these protections; guarded tests report UNSUPPORTED/UNTESTED, while unguarded tests retain raw failures.

cases.name: mmap/11-3
cases.reason: Requires page-protection faults (SIGSEGV/SIGBUS or execute/read/write protection). No MMU enforces these protections; guarded tests report UNSUPPORTED/UNTESTED, while unguarded tests retain raw failures.

cases.name: mmap/24-2
cases.reason: Requires MAP_FIXED virtual-address replacement/placement; no-MMU Linux rejects it with EINVAL. The expected replacement or address-limit errno cannot be supplied by a physical-address allocator.
